{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16
|gr1= Camera Control
|gr2= Remote Control

|descr= Returns the person the camera is focused on. If you need the vehicle, see [[cameraOn]].

|s1= [[focusOn]]

|r1= [[Object]] - controlled person or [[objNull]] if no unit is controlled

|x1= <sqf>private _currentlyControlledUnit = focusOn;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
if (isNull player) exitWith { /* no player */ };

if (player == focusOn) then
{
	hint "You are controlling your player unit";
}
else
{
	hint "You are remote-controlling a unit";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[switchCamera]] [[cameraView]] [[cameraEffect]] [[cameraOn]] [[remoteControl]]
}}
